summary.intent: Add Phase 36 to the roadmap for refactoring upload progress from a popup modal to inline display in the file browser, then capture implementation decisions via the discuss-phase workflow.
summary.outcome: Phase 36 was created with a branch (feat/phase-36-inline-upload-progress), and a CONTEXT.md was written with locked decisions covering inline placement, minimal progress bar UI, lifecycle/dismissal behavior, and cancel/error UX.

repo: Upload progress is currently handled by an UploadModal popup widget in the bottom-right corner
UI follows a terminal aesthetic established across all phases
State management uses Zustand store pattern throughout
SDK upload pipeline (encrypt → IPFS → register) is unchanged by UI refactors
There is a pending todo to offload large file encryption to a Web Worker (separate from UI concerns)

code.finding: Locked decisions: inline placement at alphabetical position in file list, thin progress bar under filename (no percentage text), brief green flash (~1s) then swap to normal row, per-file cancel button that removes row immediately, inline red bar error state with retry and dismiss buttons

workflow: discuss_mode config controls whether discuss-phase runs in 'discuss' (interactive) or 'assumptions' (codebase-first) mode
gsd-tools init phase-op provides phase metadata (phase_dir, padded_phase, has_context, has_plans, etc.) needed before any phase operation
Web Worker encryption todo was deliberately deferred — it's a performance concern separate from progress display UX

open_items: Offload large file encryption to Web Worker (todo exists, deferred — separate phase)
Phase 36 planning not yet started — next step is /gsd:plan-phase 36
